raw_text:
PLAN "3-Week Powerlifting Peak"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "Peak squat bench deadlift for meet"

PHASES
  PHASE "Phase 1 Intensification" (1 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 75m "Heavy Squat and Bench":
        warmup:
          cycling 8m
          leg_swings 2m
          hip_circles 2m
          arm_circles 2m
        main straight_sets:
          squat 4x3 rpe 8 rest 240 seconds
          bench_press 4x3 rpe 8 rest 240 seconds
          front_squat 2x5 rpe 6 rest 150 seconds
          barbell_row 3x6 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          plank 3x30 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          quad_stretch 2m
          chest_stretch 2m
      DAY Wednesday training 70m "Heavy Deadlift and Press":
        warmup:
          rowing 8m
          hip_circles 2m
          inchworm 2m
        main straight_sets:
          deadlift 4x2 rpe 8 rest 240 seconds
          overhead_press 3x5 rpe 7 rest 150 seconds
          romanian_deadlift 2x6 rpe 6 rest 150 seconds
          lat_pulldown 3x8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          face_pull 3x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch 2m
          back_stretch 2m
      DAY Friday training 70m "Volume Squat and Bench":
        warmup:
          cycling 8m
          leg_swings 2m
          arm_circles 2m
        main straight_sets:
          squat 3x2 rpe 8 rest 240 seconds
          bench_press 5x2 rpe 8 rest 210 seconds
          incline_press 2x6 rpe 6 rest 120 seconds
          dumbbell_row 3x8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          dead_bug 3x8 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          hip_flexor_stretch 2m
          shoulder_stretch 2m
      DAY Saturday training 50m "Light Deadlift Technique":
        warmup:
          walking 8m
          hip_circles 2m
        main straight_sets:
          deadlift 3x3 rpe 6 rest 180 seconds
          bench_press 3x5 rpe 6 rest 150 seconds
          back_extension 2x10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          pigeon_pose 2m
          child_pose 2m
  PHASE "Phase 2 Taper" (1 weeks):
    WEEK 2:
      DAY Monday training 65m "Openers Plus Squat and Bench":
        warmup:
          cycling 8m
          leg_swings 2m
          arm_circles 2m
        main straight_sets:
          squat 3x1 rpe 8 rest 240 seconds
          squat 2x3 rpe 7 rest 180 seconds
          bench_press 3x1 rpe 8 rest 240 seconds
          bench_press 2x3 rpe 7 rest 180 seconds
          barbell_row 2x6 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          quad_stretch 2m
          chest_stretch 2m
      DAY Wednesday training 55m "Deadlift Single":
        warmup:
          rowing 8m
          hip_circles 2m
          inchworm 2m
        main straight_sets:
          deadlift 2x1 rpe 8 rest 240 seconds
          deadlift 2x2 rpe 7 rest 180 seconds
          overhead_press 2x5 rpe 6 rest 120 seconds
          face_pull 2x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch 2m
          back_stretch 2m
      DAY Friday training 50m "Speed Squat and Bench":
        warmup:
          cycling 8m
          leg_swings 2m
          arm_circles 2m
        main straight_sets:
          squat 4x2 rpe 6 rest 150 seconds
          bench_press 4x2 rpe 6 rest 150 seconds
          lat_pulldown 2x8 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          plank 2x30 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          hip_flexor_stretch 2m
          shoulder_stretch 2m
  PHASE "Phase 3 Meet Week" (1 weeks):
    WEEK 3:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Opener Rehearsal":
        warmup:
          cycling 8m
          leg_swings 2m
          arm_circles 2m
        main straight_sets:
          squat 2x1 rpe 7 rest 240 seconds
          bench_press 2x1 rpe 7 rest 240 seconds
          deadlift 1x1 rpe 7 rest 240 seconds
        cooldown:
          quad_stretch 2m
          hamstring_stretch 2m
      DAY Wednesday training 30m "Light Primer":
        warmup:
          walking 8m
          hip_circles 2m
          arm_circles 2m
        main straight_sets:
          squat 3x3 rpe 5 rest 120 seconds
          bench_press 3x3 rpe 5 rest 120 seconds
        cooldown:
          cat_cow 2m
          child_pose 2m
      DAY Thursday training 20m "Mobility Shakeout":
        warmup:
          walking 10m
        main straight_sets:
          glute_bridge 2x10 rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
          push_up 2x8 rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          pigeon_pose 2m
          chest_stretch 2m
          diaphragmatic_breathing 3m
      DAY Friday training 15m "Rest and Walk":
        warmup:
          walking 10m
        main straight_sets:
          dead_bug 2x6 rpe 3 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          spinal_twist 2m
          diaphragmatic_breathing 3m

goals.name: Peak squat bench deadlift for meet
